title: Edit a group so every placed instance changes
task: Change the elements inside a model group so all other placed instances of the group change too. There is no group edit mode in the API: ungroup one instance, edit, regroup into a new GroupType, reassign the other instances to it.

pitfalls.symptom: 'Changes to groups are allowed only in group edit mode... Use the Ungroup option'; run rolled back.
pitfalls.cause: Two or more instances placed; Revit refuses in-place member edits (one instance: allowed with a warning).

pitfalls.symptom: Member ElementIds captured before setting Group.GroupType no longer resolve.
Verifying the edit by comparing member coordinates to PlaceGroup's origin argument gives a false negative.
pitfalls.cause: Placed members are not at the absolute coordinates the origin implies.
pitfalls.fix: Compare two instances of the same GroupType against each other.
